description: Migrate a production Elasticsearch 7.10 cluster (10 nodes, 5TB data, 50 indices) to OpenSearch 2.x. The migration must follow: take snapshots of the ES cluster (to S3), provision an OpenSearch cluster, restore snapshots into OpenSearch, run a reindex step for any incompatible index mappings, run a dual-query period (application queries both clusters, compares results), execute cutover (switch application to OpenSearch only), verify, and retire the old ES cluster. A rollback plan must exist (revert to ES, re-route queries). Risk factors: index format incompatibility between ES 7.x and OpenSearch 2.x, mapping changes requiring reindex, query DSL differences, and search result ordering changes. Tools available: elasticsearch-curator, opensearch-cli, S3 snapshots, curl, jq, application feature flags.
